data.body: Related to (NOT a duplicate of) 56b7-b21a (in_progress, another session): 56b7 frames the fix as 'pin uv' (unpinned -> setup-uv fetches remote manifest). THIS ticket asserts setup-uv still fetches the version manifest for the artifact URL on EVERY job EVEN WHEN uv is pinned -- i.e. 56b7's pin may not fully eliminate the per-job network fetch. Keep both open: verify after 56b7 lands whether the fetch persists; if so, this needs its own fix (e.g. pin the setup-uv action to a manifest-free path / cache the manifest). Not deduping to avoid masking a residual. Flagged by debug-orchestrator sweep.
